The '''Imperial Orbital Station''' was a [[Space station/Legends|space station]], belonging to the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Makeb]] during the [[Galactic War]]. In the weeks following the [[Conquest of Makeb|invasion]] of the planet by the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]], the space station was used as a staging point for Imperial operations.<ref name="Countdown to Doomsday" />

*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]'' {{1st}}
